# @name: Rug select probe

# @description: Clicks points around the rug and logs which object each click selects.

# SETUP: housing mode (H bar visible), soil placed on the rug, nothing selected, rug in view.

block wait_world {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
        log '[P] ERROR: WorldView not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_bottom {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'ObjectPlacementWindow', 'ObjectPlacementBottom', 'ObjectPlacementSubWindow', 'BottomFrame'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'ObjectPlacementWindow', 'ObjectPlacementBottom', 'ObjectPlacementSubWindow', 'BottomFrame'] {
        log '[P] ERROR: housing placement bar (press H first) not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
log '[P] === Rug select probe ==='
call wait_world
call wait_bottom
